# Home dashboard

A whole home view built from the entity cards and the power flow card. Presence and status tiles at the top, one list per room with toggles and positions, scenes, modes and the home's power at the end. Everything here is interactive: toggle the lights, activate a scene, open the more-info dialog.

<DashboardGrid b64="">

```yaml
- column_span: 3
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Home, icon: mdi:home }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: person.alex
      visual: badge
      rules:
        - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
        - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: person.sam
      visual: badge
      rules:
        - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
        - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: person.kim
      visual: badge
      rules:
        - { state: home, color: green, icon: mdi:account, label: Home }
        - { state: not_home, color: grey, icon: mdi:account-arrow-right, label: Away }
      grid_options: { columns: 4 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen
      name: Open windows
      icon: mdi:window-open-variant
      value: "{{ states.binary_sensor | selectattr('attributes.device_class', 'eq', 'window') | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count }}"
      rules:
        - { below: 1, color: green, label: All closed }
        - { above: 1, color: red, label: Open }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: light.living_room
      name: Lights on
      icon: mdi:lightbulb-group
      color: amber
      value: "{{ states.light | selectattr('state', 'eq', 'on') | list | count }} of {{ states.light | list | count }}"
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: sensor.washer_status
      name: Washing machine
      secondary: "{{ states('sensor.washer_remaining') }} min left"
      visual: badge
      rules:
        - { state: run, color: green, icon: mdi:washing-machine, label: Running }
        - { state: end, color: teal, icon: mdi:washing-machine-alert, label: Done, tint_card: true }
        - { state: power_off, color: grey, icon: mdi:washing-machine-off, label: "Off" }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
    - type: custom:entity-card
      entity: vacuum.robot
      name: Robot vacuum
      secondary: "{{ states('sensor.robot_current_room') }} · {{ states('sensor.robot_battery') }} %"
      visual: badge
      rules:
        - { state: docked, color: green, icon: mdi:robot-vacuum, label: Docked }
        - { state: cleaning, color: blue, icon: mdi:robot-vacuum, label: Cleaning }
        - { state: returning, color: teal, icon: mdi:home-import-outline, label: Returning }
      grid_options: { columns: 6 }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Ground floor, icon: mdi:home-floor-0 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Living room
      icon: mdi:sofa
      entities:
        - entity: light.living_room
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: light.dining_table
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: cover.living_room_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          visual: bar
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: cover.toggle
            target: { entity_id: cover.living_room_blinds }
        - entity: climate.living_room
          name: Heating
          icon: mdi:radiator
          color: orange
          attribute: current_temperature
          unit: °C
          decimals: 1
        - entity: media_player.living_room_tv
          name: TV
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: playing, color: green, icon: mdi:play-circle, label: Playing }
            - { state: idle, color: grey, icon: mdi:television, label: Idle }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:television-off, label: "Off" }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Kitchen
      icon: mdi:silverware-fork-knife
      entities:
        - entity: light.kitchen
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: switch.coffee_machine
          icon: mdi:coffee-maker
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: brown, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_kitchen
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
        - entity: sensor.kitchen_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue }
            - { below: 24, color: green }
            - { above: 24, color: orange }
        - entity: sensor.dishwasher_status
          name: Dishwasher
          visual: badge
          rules:
            - { state: run, color: green, icon: mdi:dishwasher, label: Running }
            - { state: end, color: teal, icon: mdi:dishwasher-alert, label: Done }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:dishwasher-off, label: "Off" }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Hallway
      icon: mdi:door
      entities:
        - entity: light.hallway
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: binary_sensor.door_front
          name: Front door
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:door-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:door-closed, label: Closed }
        - entity: binary_sensor.motion_hallway
          name: Motion
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, icon: mdi:motion-sensor, label: Detected }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, icon: mdi:motion-sensor-off, label: Clear }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Upstairs, icon: mdi:home-floor-1 }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Bedroom
      icon: mdi:bed
      entities:
        - entity: light.bedroom
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: cover.bedroom_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          visual: bar
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: cover.toggle
            target: { entity_id: cover.bedroom_blinds }
        - entity: sensor.bedroom_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 17, color: blue, label: Cold }
            - { below: 21, color: green, label: Good for sleep }
            - { above: 21, color: orange, label: Warm }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bedroom
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Office
      icon: mdi:desk
      entities:
        - entity: light.office
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: light.desk_lamp
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: amber, label: "On" }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: "Off" }
          toggle: true
        - entity: cover.office_blinds
          name: Blinds
          icon: mdi:window-shutter
          attribute: current_position
          unit: "%"
          visual: bar
        - entity: sensor.office_co2
          name: CO₂
          visual: strip
          rules:
            - { below: 800, color: green }
            - { below: 1200, color: amber, label: Stuffy }
            - { above: 1200, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - entity: sensor.office_temperature
          name: Temperature
          decimals: 1
          rules:
            - { below: 19, color: blue }
            - { below: 24, color: green }
            - { above: 24, color: orange, label: Warm }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Bathroom
      icon: mdi:shower
      entities:
        - entity: sensor.bathroom_humidity
          name: Humidity
          visual: bar
          min: 30
          max: 100
          rules:
            - { below: 60, color: green }
            - { below: 70, color: amber, label: Humid }
            - { above: 70, color: red, label: Ventilate }
        - { entity: sensor.bathroom_temperature, name: Temperature, color: teal, decimals: 1 }
        - entity: binary_sensor.window_bathroom
          name: Window
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: red, icon: mdi:window-open, label: Open }
            - { state: "off", color: green, icon: mdi:window-closed, label: Closed }
- column_span: 1
  cards:
    - { type: heading, heading: Scenes & modes, icon: mdi:palette }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Scenes
      icon: mdi:palette
      entities:
        - entity: scene.bright
          color: amber
          value: Activate
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.bright } }
        - entity: scene.dimmed
          color: orange
          value: Activate
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.dimmed } }
        - entity: scene.dinner
          color: deep-orange
          value: Activate
          tap_action: { action: perform-action, perform_action: scene.turn_on, target: { entity_id: scene.dinner } }
        - entity: scene.movie_night
          color: deep-purple
          value: Activate
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: scene.turn_on
            target: { entity_id: scene.movie_night }
        - entity: scene.good_night
          color: indigo
          value: Activate
          tap_action:
            action: perform-action
            perform_action: scene.turn_on
            target: { entity_id: scene.good_night }
    - type: custom:entity-group-card
      title: Modes
      icon: mdi:toggle-switch-outline
      entities:
        - entity: input_boolean.night_mode
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: indigo, label: Active }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: Inactive }
          toggle: true
        - entity: input_boolean.guest_mode
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: pink, label: Active }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: Inactive }
          toggle: true
        - entity: input_boolean.away_mode
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: blue, label: Active }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: Inactive }
          toggle: true
        - entity: input_boolean.vacation_mode
          rules:
            - { state: "on", color: teal, label: Active, tint_card: true }
            - { state: "off", color: grey, label: Inactive }
          toggle: true
    - type: custom:power-flow-card
      title: Energy
      icon: mdi:lightning-bolt
      home: sensor.power_consumption
      expensive_above: 0.35
      sources:
        - { type: solar, entity: sensor.solar_power }
        - { type: battery, power: sensor.battery_power, soc: sensor.battery_soc }
        - type: grid
          power: sensor.grid_power
          price: sensor.electricity_price
          offline: binary_sensor.grid_outage
          fossil: sensor.grid_fossil_percentage
      rules:
        - { above: 3000, color: red, label: Heavy load, tint_card: true }
```

</DashboardGrid>
